plot_images_horizontally: plot a set of NumPy or PyTorch images horizontally with optional titles and colormaps using plot_images
plot_keypoints_on_images: plot keypoints as colored scatter points on existing matplotlib images using plot_keypoints
plot_matches_between_images: plot corresponding keypoint matches between two images with colored connecting lines using plot_matches
save_plot_to_file: save the current matplotlib figure to a PNG or PDF file without white margins using save_plot
add_contour_overlay_to_image: overlay object boundary contours on an image using a rendered mask and Canny edge detection with add_contour_overlay
